period: 24 Jan 2022 to 31 Aug 2026, cumulative, EUR bn (nominal), site's central values
status: research only; not read by the pipeline

definitions.military: bilateral military aid as the site counts it: Kiel allocations (ERA loan left out) at the site's yearly totals, donated weapons at market value, minus not yet delivered by Aug 2026, military guarantees at gift value, plus the undisclosed-aid estimate
definitions.financial: bilateral budget support, loans and guarantees at gift value to Ukraine (ERA loans repaid from Russian assets left out), plus the shareholding share of new IMF, World Bank and EBRD lending
definitions.humanitarian: bilateral humanitarian aid (Kiel; UN OCHA FTS and government reports outside Kiel)
definitions.refugees: refugee hosting net of reimbursements and the host's gain on refugees' work (site part 'ref')
definitions.eu_share: the member's share of EU-level aid (site part 'euaid'), split in eu_share_split
definitions.other: private donations and extra purchases from Ukraine, which the site's total also counts
definitions.flowback: money flowing back to the donor's economy, negative (site uaBack)
definitions.total_site: site's support for Ukraine (pipeline/site_numbers.mjs uaEur); military + financial + humanitarian + refugees + eu_share + other + flowback = total_site
definitions.kiel_military: Kiel Release 31 bilateral military allocations as published (incl. the UK's ERA loan, which Kiel codes as military); EU members' imputed share of EU-level military aid in kiel_military_eu_share
definitions.military_pct_gdp: cumulative 2022 to Aug 2026 military aid as % of one year's GDP (the site's gdp field), the site's convention
definitions.quality: A: Kiel with model adjustments under 5% of the military figure; B: under 25%; C: more, or undisclosed estimate over 25%; outside Kiel: the letter of the record in gaps/aid_gaps.json; D where no aid record exists (only refugees or other parts)
